reason: Most brands just say tested, but this one names the lab and puts the report for my batch behind the QR code, so I can check it myself. At $24.99 with money back and nothing to mail, one box is a low-risk try.
objection: Made in China and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles. I would want to open that report and see the lab is real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code report did not match the batch number on the box, or the lab could not be found, I would not buy.
